headline: Veteran Actor Nana Patekar Passes Away in Goa
summary: Renowned actor Nana Patekar passed away at the age of 75 following a cardiac arrest in Goa. The Goa Police have registered an unnatural death case to conduct an inquiry and record statements regarding his sudden demise.

headline: Man Jailed After Attempting to Take Charge with Fake Job Order
summary: A man who allegedly paid Rs 27 lakh to secure a government job was arrested after arriving at the Goa excise office with a fake appointment letter. The counterfeit document falsely claimed he was appointed as the state's new Excise Commissioner.

headline: Over 400 kg of Illegal Delhi Meat Seized and Destroyed in Margao
summary: Authorities in Margao intercepted and confiscated a massive consignment of 408 kilograms of meat brought from Delhi. The entire seized quantity was subsequently destroyed by officials.

headline: Indian Coast Guard Commissions Goa-Built ICGS Ajit
summary: The Indian Coast Guard has officially commissioned ICGS Ajit, an indigenously constructed interceptor boat built in Goa. The vessel will be stationed at Okha to strengthen maritime surveillance and security.

headline: Kejriwal Promises Free Electricity and Monthly Aid for Goa Women
summary: AAP leader Arvind Kejriwal has announced six key guarantees for Goa ahead of elections, including free electricity supply. He also promised a monthly financial allowance of Rs 3,000 for women in the state.

headline: Goa Named Top Destination for Budget Off-Season Travel
summary: Goa has been featured as one of five ideal Indian destinations to visit during the off-season. Traveling during this period offers tourists fewer crowds and significantly better deals.

headline: BJP Workers Protest Mhadei River Diversion at Goa Airport
summary: BJP workers organized a protest march to the Goa airport to raise their voices against the Mhadei river diversion. The demonstration took place just ahead of the arrival of the Karnataka Chief Minister.

headline: Retired Justice Rebello Backs Citizens' Protest
summary: Retired Justice Rebello has voiced his support for the Citizens for Justice and Peace protest. He expressed solidarity with the movement, stating that "enough is enough."

headline: Inter Kashi Finalizes Football Squad Ahead of FIFA Transfer Ban
summary: Football club Inter Kashi has completed their squad registration process. The rush to finalize signings comes just before the implementation of an upcoming FIFA transfer ban.

headline: Goa Government to Unveil New AI Policy at Tech Conclave
summary: The Goa government is preparing to officially launch its new Artificial Intelligence policy. the announcement is set to take place at an upcoming technology conclave.

headline: State Invites Private Operators to Run Shivaji Maharaj Digital Museum
summary: The Goa government has offered the operations of the digital Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj museum in Farmagudi to private players. The move aims to hand over the management of the cultural site to a private operator.

headline: A Look Inside the Iconic Real-Life Goa Bungalow from 'Drishyam'
summary: A feature tour highlights the real-life Goa bungalow that served as a central location in Ajay Devgn's hit film franchise 'Drishyam'. The property has become a highly recognizable spot for cinema lovers.
